title: Preserve unknown TaskRecord fields via schema passthrough
context: Audit finding #6: TaskRecord was a strict z.object with no passthrough, unlike IssueRecord, so unknown fields on hand-authored or future records were silently stripped on the first mutation round-trip.
decision: Add .passthrough() to the TaskRecord object schema, matching IssueRecord. Unknown fields are preserved as-is on read and through every mutation; the schema stays strict on all declared fields (types, ids, timestamps). No record migration required.
consequences: Extra task fields survive mutation round-trips; no silent data loss.
A misspelled unknown field is carried along instead of flagged; mitigate with validate checks on known fields.
No migration needed: existing records have no unknown fields.
